Hiding isn't enough. Prove it.

Hide and seek across a real city. Your phone makes you prove where you're hiding, on a timer, to the person hunting you.

Nine cards. The whole game.

Hide and seek across a real city, played with people you already know. One code, one zone, thirty minutes. Every few minutes your phone asks you to prove where you are hiding, and the proof goes straight to the person hunting you.

Miss the window and you are blacked out. The whole group sees it.

Everyone on the list gets a link to an exclusive in-game reward the day it drops.
